name: solarsim
description: Interactive educational physics sandbox — quarks to solar system

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "journey,solar" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix apps/universe-journey" "npm run dev --prefix apps/solar-system"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/universe-journey && npm run build --prefix apps/solar-system
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/universe-journey && npm install --prefix apps/solar-system
